methodology.rawUnits: metres before XZ scale 1.65; Y and width unchanged
methodology.profile: periodic forward/backward centre-line envelope; max of production AI 18 m heading window and local 4 m window
methodology.physicalLateralAcceleration: 44 m/s² soft player limit with exact full-lock tanh and steering-speed response
methodology.simulation: unmodified createRacing, 60 Hz, default gearbox and feel, normal player inputs only, 2 laps, all 32 gates
methodology.controls: same deterministic good-player controller; AI and faster physical target trials; 1.5% target margin
methodology.timeTrial: stock equipment, no opponents, no pad/pickup, no nitro, no drift, no drafting; walls remain enabled
methodology.fractions: distance weighted; spatial envelopes periodic, actual measurements second complete rolling lap
methodology.corner25Percent: all named sharp/hairpin corner intervals: maximum AI and physical-envelope speeds <= 75% stock stage.playerSpeed
methodology.spatialLimit: spatial envelope omits 0.16 s gear shifts; actual headless times include shifts; neither envelope is a global optimal racing line
